text_block_list.text:
The day of the Takarazuka Kinen. Time has 
passed since her setback in the Mainichi 
Okan... and El Condor Pasa has staged a 
magnificent comeback.

El Condor Pasa declares to Silence Suzuka 
that even if there isn't a single chance 
of winning, she will still manage to claim 
victory.

However, Silence Suzuka realized that El 
Condor Pasa possessed a "special power" 
that she herself lacked.

However, she had no intention of losing 
either. Neither of them willing to back 
down... they would soon clash in a fierce 
showdown!
